description: Automotive reports and data centre is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Economic Development, Job Creation and Trade. Dataset provides analysis, articles and reports on global automotive trends; this includes topics such as fuel economy trends, national union wage rates, production and sales trends, and monthly and annual industry analysis for global markets. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Economic Development, Job Creation and Trade. Its tags are Affaires et économie, Business and economy, Economy and Business, Économie et affaires. The portal shows 2021-01-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support digital infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
